description: SeaWiFS: relative spectral responses of the eight bands 412-865 nm from NASA OBPG's table seawifs_rsrs.txt.
facility_description: SeaStar (OrbView-2) carried SeaWiFS; OBPG names its NetCDF table orbview-2_seawifs_RSR.nc.

links.label: OBPG Sensor Spectral Characterization (RSR tables)
links.source: NASA GSFC Ocean Biology Processing Group

licence.scope: NASA Science Mission Directorate information policy (agency-wide page linked from the OB.DAAC footer); the OBPG RSR tables page and files state no terms of their own; the MISR NetCDF file's 'license' attribute points to NASA's earth-science data-information policy.

notes: OBPG's columns are not peak-normalised (peaks 8.2-26.2); each band is divided by its maximum. Rows with -999 dropped. Pivots agree with SVO's archived SeaWiFS records to <= 0.16 % except band865 (-0.76 %). DetectorType energy assumed.
